question: 系统一共收录了多少名患者？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_patient

question: 检验结果事实表里一共有多少条记录？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_lab_result

question: 频次为每日两次（bid）的用药记录有多少条？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_medication WHERE frequency = 'bid'

question: 门诊类型的就诊一共有多少人次？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_visit WHERE visit_type = '门诊'

question: 就诊量最高的前五个科室及其就诊次数分别是多少？
goldenSql: SELECT CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(dept_code, ':', c) ORDER BY c DESC, dept_code SEPARATOR ', '), ']') FROM (SELECT dept_code, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_visit GROUP BY dept_code ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5) t

question: 各医保类型的患者分别有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(insurance_type, ':', c) ORDER BY insurance_type SEPARATOR ', '), ']') FROM (SELECT insurance_type, COUNT(*) c FROM dim_patient GROUP BY insurance_type) t

question: 被诊断为原发性高血压的患者有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM dim_patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_diagnosis t WHERE t.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t.disease_code = 'I10')

question: 使用过阿托伐他汀的患者有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM dim_patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_medication t WHERE t.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t.drug_code = 'D_ATORVASTATIN')

question: 近一个月做过糖化血红蛋白检验且结果异常的患者有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM dim_patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_lab_result t WHERE t.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t.test_code = 'LAB_HBA1C' AND t.is_abnormal = 1 AND t.test_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY))

question: 在内分泌科就诊过的患者有多少人？

question: 开药记录最多的前五种药品及其记录数分别是多少？
goldenSql: SELECT CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(drug_code, ':', c) ORDER BY c DESC, drug_code SEPARATOR ', '), ']') FROM (SELECT drug_code, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_medication GROUP BY drug_code ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5) t

question: 住院就诊的患者中男性和女性各有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(gender, ':', c) ORDER BY gender SEPARATOR ', '), ']') FROM (SELECT p.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) c FROM dim_patient p JOIN fact_visit v ON v.patient_id = p.patient_id AND v.visit_type = '住院' GROUP BY p.gender) t

question: 近三个月诊断为2型糖尿病且糖化血红蛋白大于8、使用二甲双胍治疗的患者有多少人？

question: 2型糖尿病患者的糖化血红蛋白平均值是多少？

question: 诊断为2型糖尿病且使用降糖药（口服降糖药或胰岛素）治疗的患者有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM dim_patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_diagnosis t0 WHERE t0.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t0.disease_code = 'E11') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_medication t1 WHERE t1.patient_id = p.patient_id AND (t1.drug_code IN ('D_METFORMIN','D_GLIMEPIRIDE','D_GLIBENCLAMIDE','D_GLICLAZIDE','D_GLIPIZIDE','D_REPAGLINIDE','D_ACARBOSE','D_VOGLIBOSE','D_PIOGLITAZONE','D_SITAGLIPTIN','D_EMPAGLIFLOZIN','D_DAPAGLIFLOZIN') OR t1.drug_code LIKE 'D_INSULIN%'))

question: 诊断为2型糖尿病、糖化血红蛋白大于9且近三个月使用胰岛素治疗的患者有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM dim_patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_diagnosis t0 WHERE t0.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t0.disease_code = 'E11') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_lab_result t1 WHERE t1.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t1.test_code = 'LAB_HBA1C' AND t1.result_value > 9) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_medication t2 WHERE t2.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t2.drug_code LIKE 'D_INSULIN%' AND t2.prescribe_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY))

question: 近三个月做过肌酐检验的慢性肾脏病患者有多少人？

question: 2型糖尿病患者最常合并的其他诊断（不含糖尿病类）前五种及条数分别是多少？
goldenSql: SELECT CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(disease_code, ':', c) ORDER BY c DESC, disease_code SEPARATOR ', '), ']') FROM (SELECT fd.disease_code, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_diagnosis fd WHERE fd.disease_code NOT IN ('E10','E11','E12','E13','E14') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_diagnosis e WHERE e.patient_id = fd.patient_id AND e.disease_code = 'E11') GROUP BY fd.disease_code ORDER BY c DESC, fd.disease_code LIMIT 5) t

question: 2型糖尿病患者按年龄分为青年（小于45岁）、中年（45-59岁）、老年（60岁及以上）各有多少人？
goldenSql: SELECT CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(bucket, ':', c) ORDER BY bucket SEPARATOR ', '), ']') FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) < 45 THEN '青年(<45)' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) < 60 THEN '中年(45-59)' ELSE '老年(>=60)' END AS bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) c FROM dim_patient p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_diagnosis t0 WHERE t0.patient_id = p.patient_id AND t0.disease_code = 'E11') GROUP BY bucket) t
